ask: A county sheriff's outside-broadcast truck: a medium box truck whose box is an open stage. Low-poly toy style, big flat faces, no fine detail. White cab and stage with a teal lower half and one pink stripe, a dark video screen along each side of the stage, a small pink podium on top with room for one standing figure, a camera on a crane arm reaching over the back, a satellite dish and two loudspeakers behind the cab, a light bar on the cab roof with a pink lamp on the left and a cyan lamp on the right. No lettering, no badges, generic shape.
why: It is the face of heat 5. The code version is boxes drawn over a pickup's chassis until the Hogfish ships (src/actors/cops-heavy-draw.js).
